crudSummary.create: Add new musical instruments with technical specifications, high-resolution media galleries, retail pricing (LKR), warranty policies, and brand taxonomy.
crudSummary.read: Browse instruments by category, execute multi-faceted filters (brand, price bracket, specifications), and render side-by-side instrument comparison matrices.
crudSummary.update: Modify product descriptions, update prices and active promotional discounts, revise technical specs, and adjust display order/media.
crudSummary.delete: Delist discontinued musical gear, delete obsolete categories, or soft-delete archived products from public visibility.

assignedErrors.name: Invalid Price or Discount Boundary
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when retail price is non-numeric, zero, or negative, or when promotional discount price exceeds the retail price.
assignedErrors.message: Retail price must be greater than zero, and discount price cannot be negative or exceed the retail price.

assignedErrors.name: Missing Mandatory Technical Specifications
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when adding or updating an instrument without required technical specifications (material, dimensions, pickups, voices, or tuning).
assignedErrors.message: Technical specifications are mandatory for musical instruments (e.g., material, dimensions, voices, or pickup setup).

assignedErrors.name: Comparison Matrix Capacity Exceeded
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when a user requests a side-by-side comparison of more than 4 musical instruments concurrently.
assignedErrors.message: Instrument comparison is limited to a maximum of 4 instruments side-by-side.

endpointsTested: GET /api/products - Browse and search catalog with category, brand, price filters
GET /api/products/:id - Retrieve full instrument details and specifications
POST /api/products - Add new musical instrument to catalog
PUT /api/products/:id - Update descriptions, pricing, discounts, and specs
DELETE /api/products/:id - Delist/soft-delete instrument from public view
